verdict.rationale: Meltano documents access to 600+ built-in connectors spanning SaaS APIs, databases, and files, backed by MeltanoHub, and community evidence (GitLab data team, SDK praise) corroborates real-world use of these connectors and the ability to build custom ones when needed. Missing for 10: independent quantitative freshness/maintenance data on connector catalog and broader third-party validation beyond a couple of HN comments.
